name: California Academy of Sciences
address: 55 Music Concourse Dr, San Francisco, CA 94118
tagline: Aquarium, planetarium, natural history museum, and rainforest under one living roof.
description: A natural history museum, a Steinhart Aquarium, the Morrison Planetarium, and a four-story enclosed rainforest, all under a 2.5-acre living roof designed by Renzo Piano. NightLife events on Thursdays are 21+ only and drink-friendly.
hours_summary: Mon–Sat 9:30 AM – 5 PM · Sun 11 AM – 5 PM
review_long:
Four major institutions under one roof: a natural history museum, an aquarium with the largest coral reef on display in any US museum, a planetarium dome, and a four-story enclosed Costa Rican rainforest with a glass canopy walk and a basement-level Amazon flooded forest. The roof itself, planted with native California species, is open to visitors.

NightLife on Thursdays (21+, ticketed separately) turns the whole museum into an after-hours venue with cocktails.
